diagnostic.purpose: Repeat HUD FULL/MIN/OFF A/B on the river/village map with BVH frustum selection available in the same preview. No FPS promise.
diagnostic.map: old sym9 village/river map from immutable Perspective/Tex3 parent: maps/kordos/kordos.3d, baked lightmap/kordod.vla, Tex3 slots forest/map-selo1/river
diagnostic.renderer: immutable parent StaticRoomBvhMesh class bytes retained; StaticRoomPerspectiveStats used only as fractional wall-clock timer

selection_keys.key7: BVH ON (face-AABB frustum BVH, leaf <=8; not occlusion/BSP)
selection_keys.key9: GRID (same mesh setBvhEnabled(false), legacy 4x4 full-face-AABB cells)
selection_keys.note: keys 7/9 are selection in this diagnostic, not strafe

hud_modes.key1: FULL: six lines on 90px panel, drawn every frame
hud_modes.key3: MIN: heading + N/C/I on 30px panel, drawn every frame
hud_modes.key0: OFF: no panel/text after map Image copy; stats still collected
hud_modes.star: in OFF, freeze and show last completed FULL result; press star again to resume with fresh warmup

diagnostic.default: BVH ON + FULL HUD at original START pose/yaw0
diagnostic.key5: home; preserves selected BVH/GRID and HUD mode, resets stats
diagnostic.movement: 2/8 move, 4/6 turn; no strafe because 7/9 select BVH/GRID
diagnostic.pump: same worker repaint()+serviceRepaints()+sleep(1) in all modes; not FramePump SELF/S0
diagnostic.alpha: original thresholds ON; no alpha-disable code in this preview path
diagnostic.depth: ON; river depth write OFF as in parent materials
diagnostic.river: all 4 cached frames, speed6, mode7, UV/order unchanged
diagnostic.fallback: selection-index OOM keeps whole-room native path and heading shows MEM; culling comparison is then invalid
diagnostic.stats_note: Wall-clock API timings and submitted counters, NOT GPU timestamps or proven LCD flips
